dogecoin.text: #DOGE #dogecoin was invented as a joke and it is worthless because an unlimited supply can be created.  But everyone is making a lot of money on it, just like they did during the tulip bubble.  So enjoy until it crashes.  But if you are smart, you will switch to other alt coins.

Today's stars on the cryptocurrencies Top 10 were worthless garbage #dogecoin, currently up 26%, Ethereum Classic, part of the Ethereum family, up 29% ( I predict that Ethereum will become the dominant cryptocurrency surpassing #Bitcoin), and #Chainlink LINK, one of my top five.

#dogecoin is almost completely worthless garbage that was created as a meme for a joke. It has no real value because an unlimited supply of it can be created.  Stick to ones that are the real deal, like #XRP and #ADA.  Or just hold #ETH long term.  ETH/BTC is an ideal investment.
@MEESTERCLAY In the past 24 hours, my fave ETH is up 9.7% and $DOGE is down 9%, a difference of 18.7% better off if you were in the long term safety and quality of ETH.

Sooner or later a big correction will come.  And I'll go out on a limb here and say that $DOGE will correct faster and more than the rest of the Top 15 by volume.  I have a saying that I invented:  "Sooner or later, reality always prevails."
